message.content: Pandas belong to the order Carnivora, but they diverged from other carnivores early on. Their lineage split from the common ancestor of bears around 20–25 million years ago. Over time, they evolved specialized traits—such as a pseudo‑thumb and a diet heavily reliant on bamboo—to adapt to their forested habitats. The giant panda’s modern form emerged roughly 2–3 million years ago, with its distinctive black‑and‑white coloration and bamboo‑specialized digestive system.
